_context.access.short.workspace: Short name of an access mode: only the members of the workspace can open the link.
_context.access.short.invited: Short name of an access mode: only the people invited by email can open the link.
_context.access.workspaceFallback: Stands in for the name of a workspace that has none.
_context.access.label.workspace: {workspace} is the name of the workspace.
_context.access.anyoneAt: An invite that covers a whole email domain. {domain} is a domain such as company.com.
_context.gate.locked: Screen reader label of the picture of a locked page. {workspace} is the workspace that owns it.
_context.gate.madeWith: Link to the Rerun website, at the bottom of a published page.
_context.viewer.report: Link at the bottom of a published page to report abusive content to Rerun.
_context.viewer.updated: {when} is a relative date already translated, such as 'yesterday' or '5 min ago'.
_context.csv.meta: Size of a table. {truncated} is true when the table goes on past what is shown: the row count is then followed by a plus sign.
_context.row.more: Screen reader label of the button that opens the menu of a published link.
_context.list.filterAll: Filter chip showing every published link, followed by their count. {count} is empty while the list loads.
_context.list.fallbackCoworker: Stands in for the name of a coworker that no longer exists.
_context.chat.fallbackCoworker: Stands in for the name of a coworker that no longer exists.
_context.chat.copy: Button that copies the link of a published page.
_context.chat.madePublicByYou: Status under a published link once the user agreed to make it public.
_context.chat.keptFor: Status under a published link once the user refused to make it public. {workspace} is the name of the workspace.
_context.share.title: Title of the dialog where the user chooses who can open a published link.
_context.share.publicOff: Why the Public option is greyed out. {workspace} is the name of the workspace.
_context.share.noEmail: Why the Invited option is greyed out: this self-hosted server is not set up to send emails.
_context.share.passwordSet: Placeholder of the password field when the link already has a password.
_context.policy.label: Workspace setting: who may make a published link public.
_context.share.description: Under the title of the share dialog of a published page: it sets who can open the page and which tables of the workspace's database the page reads or writes.
_context.share.data.title: Heading of the list of database tables a published page reads live.
_context.share.data.empty: Shown in place of the list when the page reads no table: its content is frozen as it was published.
_context.share.data.rows: Number of rows in a database table.
_context.share.data.tableMeta: Under a table name: {owner} is whose database holds it (the workspace, or a coworker's name), {rows} the number of rows, already formatted.
_context.share.data.workspace: Names the workspace's shared database, as opposed to a coworker's own.
_context.share.data.grant.read.label: What a published page may do with a table: show its rows to visitors.
_context.share.data.grant.write.label: What a published page may do with a table: show its rows, and let visitors add and edit rows.
_context.share.data.grant.off.label: What a published page may do with a table: nothing, the table is taken off the page.
_context.share.data.publicWrite: Warning shown when the link is open to anyone and at least one table lets visitors add rows.
